mapping.legacy: Core DB dictionaries and FW metadata

compatibility.mapping: Parse pure immutable model; store dictionaries, sheet maps, exit codes and templates in RunSession.
Execute typed join/filter/group/concat operators over byte row sources; preserve bag/order semantics and implicit Cartesian axes. No SQL interpreter.

mapping.legacy: Reader COPY, JDBC, handshakes, loose files, shards and gRPC

compatibility.mapping: Pass typed bounded candidates directly. Support legacy artifacts as explicit import/export where useful, not required internal transport.

mapping.legacy: Python generator, constraints, bundle CLI/launcher and orchestration

compatibility.mapping: Reimplement DSL, options, FW_Seq, aliases, compile/preview, policy, repeats, resume, adaptive phases and artifact identities in Java.
Swing editor and visualizations use shared service facade; no local web server or JavaScript runtime required.
In-process JavaCompiler and typed/plugin or explicitly serialized legacy main adapter; preserve FW_VAR/FW_CUSTOM_VAR and generated source dependencies.

mapping.legacy: Executor Python and arbitrary raw Python snippets

compatibility.mapping: Java framework cannot execute arbitrary Python with no interpreter. Port each supported scenario fragment/SUT semantically; reject unported source language before generation, never treat it as Java. Author decision 2026-10-12: the core still runs no Python; the Python add-on (addons/fw-python.jar, cf.execution.sut=python) runs rendered Python candidates and the original SUT, generator and demo code with an external interpreter, as the legacy trusted-local executor did.

mapping.legacy: Executor Docker, process sandbox and remote workers

compatibility.mapping: Cooperative trusted Java execution replaces throughput/cancellation behavior; do not claim OS isolation, forcible kill, per-process RSS limits or remote distribution.
Preserve immutable five-field sample identity, attempt history, domain/infrastructure split and separate counts as Java repository projections.
Preserve objective direction, constraints, scalar and multiobjective algorithms, reports, bins, sampling, top-K and seed reproducibility; record exactness.
Pure-Java numerical optimization with typed Objective callback and numerical tolerance tests; no ProcessBuilder fallback.

mapping.legacy: LLM proposal and AI task IR/campaign tooling

compatibility.mapping: Typed proposal provider and task IR in Java. Baseline deterministic/local scripted provider; actual model inference requires a pure-Java in-process implementation and separately tested assets. Do not claim PyTorch/native acceleration parity.
Port deterministic functions and named defects faithfully; preserve intended defective policies for oracle demonstrations, not just successful paths.

mapping.legacy: SUT automation constructor and 3D sieve/shape geometry

compatibility.mapping: Port domain model, compiler/runtime, measurements and geometric decision functions to Java; compare tolerances and boundary geometry. UI equivalents belong to Java desktop.

mapping.legacy: SUT finance-stack ledger and external service integration

compatibility.mapping: Use Java in-memory domain ports with exact money/time/idempotency semantics; real external database/network operational testing is incompatible with strict all-in-JVM target.
Separate pure Java inference/math/domain ports and explicit Java data import tasks; never deserialize Python pickle inside the framework or silently stub inference.
Preserve fixture semantics, relational/metamorphic oracles and deliberate defect modes; import only code/config evidence and translate embedded Python scenario snippets.
Opt-in files with version/hash/atomic snapshot, while ordinary execution stays heap-only. Existing Analyzer reporting Snapshot is not a complete resume checkpoint.
compatibility.release-rule: Release reports list capability coverage and incompatible operational guarantees. Full pure-Java semantic parity requires all PORT_REQUIRED families claimed by the release to pass their gates; an unsupported diagnostic alone is not a port.
